contexts.text: The people carried their dough before it was leavened () = the first state of truth from good, in which there was nothing false. Dough = truth from good; for flour = truth; the dough therefrom, the good of truth; and the bread which is from the dough, the good of love. When bread = the good of love, the other things, namely, the dough and the flour = goods and truths in their order.
Large or small masses of wood, stone, or metal.
By the formation of some mass...
The whole mass so to speak began to ferment...
The raiser ceaseth from kneading the dough until it be leavened ()... = that the falsities which favour their loves they compact together as it were into a mass.
They are said to knead their dough () = when they forge doctrine from these cupidities, and according to them.
